title: AI-guided deep visual proteomics reveals recurrence-associated morpho-molecular signatures within triple-negative breast cancers
abstract: arXiv:2608.03145v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Outcome informed AI can localize prognostically relevant regions in digital pathology, but directly characterizing the molecular basis of these spatial predictions remains challenging. Here, we developed an outcome informed, AI-guided deep visual proteomics framework that uses recurrence-risk heatmaps to guide physical tissue sampling and mass spectrometry-based spatial proteomics in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC). In 156 patients, high- and low-risk regions coexisted within the tumor compartment and showed distinct nuclear and architectural features, indicating intratumoral variation beyond broad tissue identity. Guided by these maps, we physically isolated and profiled 46 AI-defined high- and low-risk tumor regions from two recurrent cases. translated_title: AI引导的深度视觉蛋白质组学揭示三阴性乳腺癌中与复发相关的形态-分子特征
translated_abstract: 结果导向的人工智能可以在数字病理学中定位与预后相关的区域，但直接表征这些空间预测背后的分子基础仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们开发了一个结果导向的、AI引导的深度视觉蛋白质组学框架，该框架利用复发风险热图来指导三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）的实体组织采样和基于质谱的空间蛋白质组学分析。在156名患者中，高风险与低风险区域共存于肿瘤区内，并表现出不同的细胞核与结构特征，表明存在超越广义组织身份的肿瘤内异质性。在这些图谱的指导下，我们从两例复发病例中物理分离并分析了46个AI定义的高风险和低风险肿瘤区域。高风险区域富集有丝分裂相关程序，而低风险区域则显示免疫和抗原呈递相关程序。我们利用在两类区域间持续差异表达的蛋白质……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究开发了一种结果导向的AI引导深度视觉蛋白质组学框架，利用复发风险热图指导三阴性乳腺癌的组织采样与质谱空间蛋白质组学分析，揭示了高风险区域富集有丝分裂程序、低风险区域富集免疫与抗原呈递程序的肿瘤内分子异质性。
en_tdlr: This study develops an outcome-informed, AI-guided deep visual proteomics framework that uses recurrence-risk heatmaps to guide tissue sampling and mass spectrometry-based spatial proteomics in triple-negative breast cancer, revealing intratumoral molecular heterogeneity with mitotic programs enriched in high-risk regions and immune/antigen-presentation programs enriched in low-risk regions.
